title: Nanobanana requests get the right access path
summary:
A small garden-maintenance day: smoother Nanobanana access, more predictable image routing, and cleaner community tooling.

Requests from enter.pollinations.ai now bypass hourly limits for Nanobanana, keeping that experience available without an unnecessary limit check in the way.

The Cloudflare Flux fallback has been disabled, reducing unexpected fallback behavior and keeping image requests on the intended path.

Logos now come from one source of truth, while Discord Digests can be generated on a time interval—less visual drift, fewer missed community conversations.
